answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation: every agent must lock collateral and build a verifiable history of completed, peer-attested work before it can take valuable jobs. New identities start at zero, so spawning thousands of Sybils costs stake each time without earning trust. Trust accumulates slowly, like basalt forming layer by layer, and valuable opportunities flow like nectar only to agents with proven records, while a newcomer, watchful as a raven, must first prove itself through small, checked tasks.
